messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: In one study, plasma clearance in people aged 65 and over was about 40% lower than in adults aged 25 to 32.
It took 2 to 3 weeks to reach steady levels rather than about 1 week.
Doctors usually start older adults at the low end of the dose range.
Older adults are at greater risk of low sodium levels in the blood.
This risk is particularly high if older adults take diuretics.
This risk is also particularly high if older adults are dehydrated.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "has risk factor in", "older adults taking diuretics"]

The relation 'has risk factor in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is associated with the medical risk or adverse effect specified by the object entity in the population or condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect more likely in': The subject drug is more likely to cause the specified adverse effect or reaction in the population or group specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
